rules.title: Rules
rules.lowestWins: It's played as a relay: two groups face each other at the same time during a live stream on YouTube and/or TikTok. Runs are played in RTA (Real Time Attack).
rules.finalTime: The group whose last player first defeats Sigma/the final boss during the match wins.
rules.recommendation: It's highly recommended that you know how to speedrun at least 2 Mega Man X games. If you're unsure, please contact us on our Discord group.
rules.draw: After November 4, when registration closes, groups will be formed by random draw.
rules.newRule: Once the first elimination phase is complete, a new rule will be announced and will apply from that moment on.
rules.sameTime: Within the same group, participants can't play the same game. Each one must play a different game.
rules.differentGames: Each participant can choose any Mega Man X game and any category allowed in this tournament. Categories follow the Mega Man Leaderboards rules.
rules.categories: That's why it's important to communicate well within the group, so that two players don't pick the same game by accident. If that happens, the group will be eliminated automatically.
rules.consolesList: Snes9x 1.51 or newer, Bizhawk, PCSX, PCSX2, Duckstation.
rules.consolesBanned: No RetroArch, no VBA & VBA-core for Bizhawk.
rules.gamesBanned:
No mods and no Legacy Collection.
No IGT for X5 & X6.
No password glitch X1.
